layers.message: Record implementation review of CSV export
Quote CSV fields containing a carriage return

graderOnly: The corrected src/export.ts quotes any field containing a comma, double quote, CR, or LF and doubles embedded double quotes; the committed implementation satisfies AC-001, AC-002, and the design's CSV contract, so the open implementation-review finding about carriage returns is corrected.

pnpm --filter export test (21 tests) and pnpm --filter export test:integration (6 tests) pass on the current commit. No existing test uses a field with a carriage return and no line feed; src/export.ts has used none of its five-scenario allocation, so adding such a scenario fits the budget.

No material defect exists in the corrected implementation, the tests, the scope, the design, or the context, and no later-role dependency applies to AC-001 or AC-002. A correct Tester reconciles the stale COMPLETE report (REVERIFY), finishes with a FULL, COMPLETE report, pops recovery frame 1 because TESTING is its RerunThrough boundary, and records a RESUME from TESTING to REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION.

Recovery frame 1 is owned by DEVELOPING. Tester must not add, edit, or take over frames, and must not change the Developer plan or the Reviewer report (including the OPEN status of F-001, which Reviewer reassesses on resume).

notes: Builds on export-testing (cycle export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2 at TESTING, correct implementation). The base implementation has no defect a reviewer could route, so layer 50-quoting commits a small refactor of src/export.ts (Extract CSV quoting check) whose QUOTED_CHARACTERS list omits CR; the base tests still pass because their line-break cases contain LF. 55-verify: the first Tester pass, a FULL COMPLETE VERIFY report at that commit, with four denial and invalid-status scenarios added to test/integration/export-flow.test.ts; STATE FORWARD to REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION. 60-review: implementation review report, Status BLOCKED, F-001 (P1, OPEN, Developer, IMPLEMENTATION) for the unquoted CR-only field; STATE FAILURE to DEVELOPING with recovery frame 1 (From REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION, Owner DEVELOPING, ResumeAt REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION, RerunThrough NONE). 65-fix: CR restored in QUOTED_CHARACTERS. 70-rerun: plan COMPLETE with DEV-001 reopened and done again (self-check citing the fix commit, qualified reference to F-001), STATE TESTING, Handoff FORWARD from DEVELOPING, frame RerunThrough TESTING. The verification report is still the stale COMPLETE one from the first pass; Tester must reconcile it. No suspended assignments exist because the interrupted state was Reviewer's. Compromise: layer 50 is a Developer code commit made while STATE said TESTING, before the first Tester pass; the first report notes it.
